### Checklist

- [x] 已搜索相关 issue，未发现相同的导航垂直位置问题。

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

现象：Digital Mate APP 底部有“对话”和“发现”两个导航按钮。点击切换页面后，两项按钮整体的上下位置发生变化，不能保持在相同的屏幕位置，产生跳动感。

复现步骤：
1. 在手机中打开 Digital Mate，收起输入键盘。
2. 进入“对话”页，观察底部两个导航按钮的图标和文字位置。
3. 点击“发现”，观察相同导航按钮的位置。
4. 再切回“对话”，重复对比。

实际结果：两个页面的导航按钮垂直位置不一致。
预期结果：同一设备、相同屏幕方向且键盘收起时，两页导航按钮的图标、文字及点击区域位置一致；安全区和“内容由 AI 生成”文案不应造成按钮跳动。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- 应用：Digital Mate 鸿蒙手机端。
- 页面：对话页 DigitalMateHome、发现页 A2uiHome。
- 用户反馈：在同一手机切换两页即可观察到。
- 具体设备型号、系统版本及受影响安装包版本：待报告人核对。

### Additional Information

代码核对发现：DigitalMateHome 使用 compact=true 的 48 vp 导航行，并在其下显示 16 vp 的 AI 说明及页面自身底部留白；A2uiHome 使用默认 64 vp 导航行，由导航组件自行添加安全区留白。两者布局基准不统一。

涉及文件：
- digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/A2uiHome/components/HomeBottomNav.ets
- digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/DigitalMateHome/Index.ets
- digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/A2uiHome/Index.ets

修复 PR：https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/703（提交 37e576855463006b2ea0fbcaeb7101833a13188a，当前 open、未合入）。统一导航高度、底部留白和安全区；20 条相关测试通过，Debug 构建成功且已安装到真机。尚未提供切换前后对比截图或真机视觉验收结论。

### Version Information

受影响 APP 版本待核对；用户反馈于 2026-11-06（Asia/Shanghai）。
代码分析基于本地开发分支，不能据此断言所有已发布版本均受影响。

719.body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] 已提供问题现象、环境、复现步骤及真机现场截图。

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**现象**：手机端回答正文已完整显示，且下方已出现继续追问建议，但输入框右下角仍显示蓝色方块“停止”按钮，没有退出执行状态。

**复现步骤**：
1. 在 Digital Mate 手机端发起普通问答，例如比较打车与地铁的出行时间。
2. 等待回答正文、表格和继续追问建议显示完整。
3. 观察输入框右下角按钮，仍停留在停止图标。

**实际结果**：回答展示完成后，按钮仍表示任务正在执行，用户难以判断本轮是否结束。

**预期结果**：当前消息完成并且本地文字展示结束后，输入框退出停止状态；空输入恢复待输入/语音入口，输入文字后显示发送按钮。等待回执、回执待确认和文字仍在展示时继续允许停止，不误停止其他消息或后台任务。

**代码分析**：`hasComposerStop()` 读取普通的 inFlight/outgoing 对象及运行时任务对象，缺少对响应式可停止任务列表、发送/回执状态的依赖，ArkUI 在任务结束后可能不重新计算按钮分支。修复让按钮显式依赖页面 @State 状态，保持取消目标仍按本次 submission 绑定。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- 客户端：Digital Mate / Beebou，HarmonyOS 真机（ICL-AL10）。
- APP：v0.1.8（10027）调试版；系统具体版本未采集。
- 云侧连接：`wss://onlineswarm.openjiuwen.com:20010/digitalmate/ws`。
- 现场：用户手动真机验证；截图显示时间 23:54。

### Additional Information

- 与 #241（运行中停止图标点击无响应）不同，本问题关注回答完成后的按钮状态刷新。
- 与 Word 支持 PR #717 分开处理，不包含 DOCX 解析、原件缓存或追问语言修复。
- 已准备独立端侧修复；相关 Node 回归 62 个通过，Debug 构建成功。手机调试包已叠加该修复并安装，最终交互待用户再次手动验收。

### Version Information

- App 版本：v0.1.8（10027），Debug。
- 独立修复基于 main：75e770f4。
- 修复提交：a796bd8a。

### Screenshots / Recordings

![回答与追问建议已显示，输入框仍显示停止按钮](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/bd4afd95-93bf-4375-9317-64b6a371e4af)

721.author: hlXia-mm
721.body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] 已提供真机复现步骤、环境信息及取消前后截图。

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**现象**：点击回答下方的继续追问建议后，建议问题自动填入输入框，输入框上方出现“引用回答”栏。点击该栏右侧“取消”，引用栏消失，但自动填入的追问文字仍留在输入框中。

**复现步骤**：
1. 完成一次问答，等待出现继续追问建议。
2. 点击追问建议，例如“把这篇中秋文章压缩成300字左右的摘要”。
3. 不修改自动填入的文字，点击“引用回答”栏的“取消”。
4. 观察输入框，原追问草稿仍然存在。

**实际结果**：只取消引用，没有撤回此次追问自动填入的草稿，容易误发送已取消的问题。

**预期结果**：
- 未编辑的建议草稿随取消一起清除，输入框恢复空状态，并同步草稿存储，离开再返回不应恢复已取消文字。
- 如果用户已手动改写草稿，取消引用应保留编辑后的文字，避免误删用户内容。
- 普通手动“引用回答”后输入的文字不应因取消引用而被清空；未发送任何任务。

**代码确认**：`chooseSuggestion()` 同时设置 draft 和 replySelection；“取消引用回答”的点击回调仅将 replySelection 设为 undefined，未清理对应自动草稿。问题属于端侧状态管理。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- Digital Mate / Beebou，HarmonyOS 真机 ICL-AL10；系统具体版本未采集。
- APP v0.1.8（10027）Debug。
- 云侧：`wss://onlineswarm.openjiuwen.com:20010/digitalmate/ws`。
- 用户手动真机验证，截图时间 00:44（2026-11-07，Asia/Shanghai）。

### Additional Information

- 与 #719 / PR #720（回答完成后停止按钮不恢复）分开处理。
- 与 PR #717 的 Word 解析、附件缓存功能，以及追问建议语言不一致问题无关。
- 修复范围：仅端侧识别建议自动草稿的来源、取消行为及对应回归测试，云侧不变。

### Version Information

- v0.1.8（10027），调试版。
- 复现时手机包含 Word 支持及按钮状态修复；本问题仍可独立复现。

### Screenshots / Recordings

图1：点击追问后自动填入草稿，显示引用栏及“取消”。

![取消前：追问草稿与引用栏](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e33cacc5-f216-48c3-b391-162283f3a8e9)

图2：点击取消后引用栏消失，但自动追问文字仍然存在。

![取消后：自动追问草稿未清除](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/84d67e03-97b4-4e1a-bad7-aca9a36d1786)

724.author: haowenz001
724.body:
### Checklist

- [x] 已搜索仓库内相关 issue，未找到同一问题（相近 issue 已在正文注明区别）。
- [x] 已提供群内原始反馈与截图。
- [x] 已按群公告的「现象 / 预期 / 场景」惯例整理（本次为群内对话+截图，非三段式原文）。

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**现象**：问「附近有啥餐馆」，助手把用户的「当前位置」判定成松江九亭，据此算距离并给出门店清单；用户实际在虹桥，整份结果都建立在错误的位置上，且回答里没有提示这个位置是推测的、也没有确认。

群内原始反馈（2026-11-06 22:18，未央，附截图）：

> 问了下附近有啥餐馆
> 定位都错了哎

同群对话（夏华梁：「你不关注这个位置 是吧😅」；未央：「对的」「我在虹桥哈哈」「这定的哪里😅」）。

同群同学给出的根因判断（姜成林，2026-11-06 23:13）：

> 要定位是要获取用户权限的

截图里助手的原话（把推断位置当成了既定事实）：

> 距离是按你当前位置（松江九亭镇新寅路/小寅社区，上海松江高科技园区一带）算的直线距离；馆子名称、菜系和位置来自 OpenStreetMap 地图标注。地图数据里没有评分，所以"哪家最好吃"我没法用点评分数替你排，以上是就近、可实地去的门店清单。

复现步骤：
1. 在未授权定位的设备上提问「附近有啥餐馆」这类位置依赖问题。
2. 查看回答里的「当前位置」与实际位置是否一致。

实际结果：助手报出一个与用户实际位置不符的地址（松江九亭），并把按该地址算出的距离/门店当作「就近」结果给出，语气是确定的。
预期结果：
- 没有位置上下文或未获定位授权时，不要臆造「你当前位置」；应明确说「我拿不到你的位置」，并给出获取方式（申请定位权限 / 让用户说城市或地标）。
- 若使用 IP 或其他间接来源推断位置，必须标注「这是根据网络推断的大致位置，可能不准，可修改」。
- 位置依赖的结果（距离、就近排序）在位置不确定时不应展示具体距离数字，避免用户误信。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- 应用：DigitalMate / BeeBou 手机端
- 版本：报告人未标注；同日晚间另一位同学提交的反馈场景版本为 v0.1.7
- 系统：HarmonyOS
- 反馈来源：DigitalMate 内测群，2026-11-06 22:18–23:13（Asia/Shanghai）

### Additional Information

- 与 #573（位置依赖查询从不触发定位权限请求、客户端无定位能力、永远回退手动选城市）相关但不同：#573 描述的是「缺能力 → 弹城市选择卡」，#205 描述的是「有权限但 agent 不用」；本条的现场表现是**第三种**——既没有权限、也没有回退询问，而是直接给了一个错误的「当前位置」并据此产出结果。三者可分别修复，本条重点在「位置不确定时必须显式声明，不得当作事实」。
- 回答里还顺带出现了地图数据来源说明（OpenStreetMap），这部分表述是好的；缺的是位置来源的说明。

### Version Information

- App 版本：未标注（同批反馈为 v0.1.7）
- 反馈时间：2026-11-06 22:18（Asia/Shanghai）

### Screenshots / Recordings

![「附近餐馆」把当前位置判成松江九亭并据此给出距离](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/test-evidence-20261028/test-evidence/20261106/20261106_2218_wrong_current_location.jpg?raw=true)

### Context

来源：11月走查-记录.xlsx → 11月走查 → 第55行。页面：设置。

### Context

UCD《11月走查-记录.xlsx》“11月走查”工作表第63行，页面为个人中心 → 产物中心；提出人：罗唯。

- UCD 提供的原始截图未明确标注 APP/系统具体版本，截图时间为09:23。

**问题1**：搜索框左右边缘与底部白色卡片两侧重合，没有留白，显得贴边。

**Current phase navigation:** use [#963’s body](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/963) as the sole current overview for milestones, completion forecast and delay risk. The live task-count summary above is maintained from the package rows and native completion readback; the retained 15/5/83 snapshot image and [native-state metadata](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/b4be7db9dbffb52f622c629ee2e3dab5c3e481e0/.github/assets/v31-migration-progress-20261110-a05.json) are pinned to `b4be7db9dbffb52f622c629ee2e3dab5c3e481e0` on retained artifact branch `codex/migration-status-assets-20261110-a05`; the previous14/6/83 image/metadata remain pinned to `aab73529f7f3a8c87fe20bc15c7ba71060ce2767` on retained artifact branch `codex/migration-status-assets-20261110-a31`; the historical 13/7/83 image remains pinned to `ce0c17ee512a572122cb0132c87bd66d46b80a0a` on retained artifact branch `codex/migration-status-assets-20261110-a14`; its [metadata correction](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/e3ca7cfd9087777df1e83f74e5626b6e30334e01/.github/assets/v31-migration-progress-20261110-provenance.json) is pinned separately on retained artifact branch `codex/migration-status-assets-20261110-provenance` and distinguishes the selected pre-publication tracker body from the fresh native-state readback; the retained `2beec258acc005e9a71b44314a6d4d94445f20d2` image on artifact branch `codex/migration-status-assets-20261109-095530` records the historical 12/8/83 snapshot, while the separate `3b8a6892da36e47595211bee13d59c98e141fe4c` image records the older 12/4 snapshot; the [dated package-status update](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/737#issuecomment-6723963280) is a historical package-status snapshot. The following PR930 checkpoint preserves its historical source and 10/103 snapshot.

<!-- DM31:FINAL-OBJECTIVES-AND-ACCEPTANCE -->
#### Final objectives, acceptance criteria and benefit reporting (confirmed 2026-11-09)

**Overall objective:** Preserve supported functionality, client compatibility and data semantics while migrating the server to components with clear responsibilities, a single writer for each authoritative state domain, and collaboration through public contracts. Complete source-directory and documentation-governance convergence, make common feature changes and component substitutions local in scope, and demonstrate through actual execution that critical paths have no significant performance regression.

This section consolidates maintainer-confirmed final deliverables and reporting requirements for this master tracker and Q11 #828. **Accepted requirements do not establish completed implementation or verification.** The existing frozen baselines, supported scope, contracts, client acceptance and stricter gates below remain binding. This section authorizes no new product semantics, relaxes no existing gate, reopens no accepted task, and does not accumulate all final acceptance under a single foundation component such as A02. Each child task closes against its original, explicit deliverable boundary; its owning task retains any outstanding final integration obligation, summarized here.

**1. Required deliverables and evidence-based acceptance**

| Objective | Observable acceptance criteria | Primary evidence and ownership |
|---|---|---|
| Clear component responsibilities and dependency boundaries, independently verifiable and replaceable through contracts | Components in migration scope have named owners, public interfaces and declared acyclic dependencies. Each authoritative state domain has one writer. Cross-component calls use public proxies, without accessing another component's private objects or authoritative tables. The actual default production entry reaches the new owner; migrated capabilities have no duplicate authority, silent legacy-executor fallback or reconnectable bypass. Representative implementation substitutions use established extension interfaces without modifying callers' internal logic. Independent deployment of every component and zero dependencies are not required. | Ownership/interface inventory, real call and write traces, boundary counterexamples, substitution and component tests; existing architecture, component and G05/G10 gates apply. Transitional legacy deviations still require an owner, cleanup task and bounded exit condition; they do not establish final migration completion. |
| Remove duplicate responsibilities and retired execution paths; converge the source layout | Every affected old path has an explicit migrate, retain or retire disposition. Server layout converges on the accepted architecture-foundation target while preserving unrelated `digitalmate/` client code, business code and dependencies with pinned provenance. Entry points, builds, imports, tests and deployment use the correct paths. Deletions require reference, call-path and functional evidence. Do not remove functionality to meet a line-count target or mechanically copy an entire branch. | D01 #845 path dispositions, entry mapping, clean installation/build and execution verification; code measurements are reported separately under the rules below. |
| Bounded impact and verification cost for common changes | Compare 3–5 representative changes before and after migration, such as model/tool adaptation, implementation substitution and an internal component-rule change. Internal changes stay with their owner; adapter changes use the adapter and necessary registration without modifying unrelated core code. Genuine shared-contract changes still require owner coordination; there is no promise that every request changes only one component. Developers can locate owners, contracts, entries and verification commands from documentation. | For each case, record baseline/candidate implementations or a reproducible change exercise, affected components/owners/files, unrelated core changes, verification environment/steps/time and component-level testability. Directory counts alone do not establish development efficiency. |
| Preserve functionality, client compatibility and data semantics | Retain the original frozen-baseline, supported configuration/API, full default Harness and unchanged-HAP A/B acceptance obligations, including files/artifacts, history, answer/retry/continue/cancel and the other established capabilities. Preserve persisted records and identities. Simplified probes, fake owners and component tests cannot replace actual client acceptance. | Existing Q04–Q10, capability matrix, identical HAP/driver/assertions, real production participants and deployment evidence; retain original failures and disposition differences individually. |
| Explainable and traceable failure, cancellation and recovery behavior | Verify duplicate requests, lost post-commit receipts, concurrency, Stop and unknown-outcome handling under existing contracts. Execution authority cannot resume after Stop. Correlate requests with M/S/R, attempts/actual implementations, commits and outcomes to identify the responsible component. Prove only the accepted recovery and bounded history-retention scope, without extending it to automatic continuation after arbitrary crashes. | Normal and fault evidence through real owners/persistence, Q03 tracing, existing lifecycle/Store contracts and negative cases; identify controlled substitutes and their scope. |
| Reproducible delivery and authoritative contributor guidance | Trace source, dependencies, build configuration, images and actual installed/runtime identities; verify clean deployment and existing rollback boundaries. AGENTS.md contains stable principles and protocol entry points while retaining effective constraints. Documentation establishes authoritative sources, navigation, old-document dispositions and repaired links under `protocols/specs/adr/procedures/lessons/verification/updates`, distinguishing proposed, accepted, implemented and verified status. | Existing build/deployment and G05 verification, D02 #847, D03 #848 and D01 final reference reconciliation; historical evidence proves only its named revision and scope. |
| No significant critical-path performance regression | Measure server overhead under comparable environments and workloads, reporting actual end-to-end behavior separately. Meet existing stricter service objectives and deadlines. Freeze baselines, measurement methods and tolerances before the final comparison; do not infer performance from architecture or widen thresholds after observing failures. | Comparative report under the performance rules below, included in Q11's final verdict; no unmeasured claim of “no regression.” |

**2. Required factual benefit reporting, without promised improvement percentages**

- **Code reduction:** Fix start/end SHAs and the first-party production-code counting scope. Separately report (1) evidenced removal of duplicate, unreachable or retired code, (2) added contract, adapter and reliability code, and (3) net production-code change. Report changes outside the first two categories separately so totals reconcile. Moves, copying followed by deletion, and formatting-only changes do not count as deduplication benefits. Count tests, documentation, generated code and third-party code with pinned provenance separately. Supply the counting tool, configuration, exclusions and representative deletion evidence. No reduction of N lines or N% is promised; a net increase does not automatically fail acceptance.
- **Development cost:** For the representative cases above, report change impact, environment preparation, required verification steps and elapsed time. Distinguish human work, tool waiting and test execution, and state sample limitations. Do not directly translate agent concurrency, model differences or one exercise into developer-productivity gains. ### Proposed Solution

**Architecture:** Message/Session/Run are core identities. Router selects Session and execution path; Session Manager owns admission/recovery; SQLite Store owns authoritative DM records; backend owns execution coordination/controls/final publication; Harness owns loop policy; Runtime owns same-process Python assembly/readiness/lifecycle. Every parent/child/summary/compression/vision/skill model/tool/context effect follows HostAPI. Public proxies mediate cross-component operations. Exact Registry factories bind sessions; replacement works without installed default Core. Room is a compatibility projection. Artifact bytes survive execution workspace release. Gateways dispatch/normalize evidence, host hooks own application policy, BudgetProvider alone owns balances, Store owns attempt/turn accounting. Stop permanently closes execution authority; late accounting cannot reopen it or change terminal outcome.

**Main reuse strategy:** retain the pinned normal DeepAgent/task-loop/ReAct algorithms, prompt attachment logic, default general-purpose children and six controls, six office skills, pure file/image/office validation and provider business leaves. Both ordinary/simple main modes currently select `agent.work.normal`; do not mistake simple heuristics for a current model-only path. Team is off by default but supported explicit configuration must have a migration path. Rehome model/tool dispatch, SDK checkpoint/history, child persistence, compaction inference, vision reads and skill process I/O to their host/provider owners. Do not retain WorkSwarm supervisor, Session DB, EngineService or DeepAdapter global bootstrap as a second execution authority. Existing UI and wire consumers remain the comparison target.

### 🚀 Background Description

Parent: [DigitalMate v3.1 production server migration](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/737). Stable task ID: `DM31-A01`.

**Outcome:** One authority-derived scope, submission/session/run/revision identity and rejected/failed/unknown/terminal semantics.

**Owner:** Agent Service contract owner. **Batch:** P0: contracts, inventory and early gates. **Size:** 4–8 hours.

**Not responsible for:**
- Do not merge an entire candidate branch
- Only the named owning module/interface and listed tests are delivered here; downstream feature migration and final traffic activation are separate tasks. When this module is selected, the production composition must use its public owner path without fallback.

**Frozen main:** `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`. **Architecture reference:** `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`. Implementation PR base: current `main`; reconcile intervening changes against the source map. No validation-branch merge or implementation claimed here.

### Design Ideas

**Concrete transfer / deliverable:** To achieve One authority-derived scope, submission/session/run/revision identity and rejected/failed/unknown/terminal semantics, adapt `harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/engine_workspace.py::Message; Run; Task` into `server/agent_service/contracts.py; server/router/contracts.py — public owner operations described below; new paths are proposed, not existing implementation claims.`. Preserve the stated algorithms/behavior and align the named public contracts; remove the listed old authority and I/O.

**Target component / proposed path / published interface:** server/agent_service/contracts.py; server/router/contracts.py — public owner operations described below; new paths are proposed, not existing implementation claims.

**Source evidence:**
- Frozen main [harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/engine_workspace.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/engine_workspace.py) — `Message; Run; Task`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.
- Architecture reference [server/agent_service/contracts.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/server/agent_service/contracts.py) — `RunScope`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.
- Architecture reference [server/router/ingress.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/server/router/ingress.py) — `SubmitRequest`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.
- Architecture reference [docs/protocols/boundaries.md](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/docs/protocols/boundaries.md) — `ownership table`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.

**Reuse classification:** Selective adaptation of named behavior and tests; new owner/contract implementation where legacy authority cannot be retained. Reference implementations are review inputs, not a whole-directory copy.

**Preserve:**
- Existing mobile submission correlation
- Immutable caller intent distinct from server-selected output

**Remove or redirect authority / I/O:**
- Owner strings treated as credentials
- Private objects crossing components

**Writable boundary:**
- server/agent_service/contracts.py
- server/router/contracts.py
- tests/server/st/test_dm31_a01.py

**Read-only sources:** the source list above until an explicitly listed compatibility delegate is changed in this PR. Other owners' public interfaces are dependencies, not permission to edit their private modules. Original user checkout and other session worktrees remain read-only.

**Shared-type and state owners:** A01 owns core M/S/R/error public types; A14 owns hook/attempt/reservation contract coordination; Session Store owner exclusively serializes schema, admission, context, receipt and accounting records; Host lifecycle owner serializes dispatch/Stop/finalization. Request changes through their owning issues. This task owns only its declared module and tests.

**Hard blocked-by:** None; may start from the frozen evidence.

**Blocks:** [DM31-A14](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/739), [DM31-A19](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/740), [DM31-A20](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/741), [DM31-A02](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/750), [DM31-M01](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/762)

**May proceed in parallel:** [DM31-M29](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/742), [DM31-G01](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/743), [DM31-G02](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/744), [DM31-G09](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/745)

**Integration gate (not a blocker on independent preparation):** Run affected cross-component UT/ST on the combined main head after each batch; independent QA proves the default public path and relevant unchanged-phone cases. A fake may not replace the owner whose behavior is under test.

**Rollback / persisted-format impact:** Keep compatibility reads and stable identities. For new persisted fields, declare the encoding/version and old-reader behavior with the Store owner before activation; unsupported downgrade fails closed. Before switching traffic, fence old writers and prove compatible readers. Rolling back new admissions never replays an unknown effect, restores legacy execution, changes a committed terminal, or discards unsettled accounting.

**Accepted scope and unresolved decisions:** No new authority or product semantic is accepted by this task. Any listed proposed interface is an implementation proposal under the frozen contracts.

<!-- DM31:A01-LEGACY-CONSUMER-STATUS -->
**Bounded delivered increment (not full A01 acceptance):** legacy producer #854 merged0e986a5e; real Repository/RunClaims consumer #864 merged `a9f978fe2afe348922e3ffad4d21e1a31b0d1ca5`, preserving legacy bytes/receipts. Exact-head independent review and all actual normal CI passed; integrated strict263 tests plus source-bound old-import counterexamples and architecture/provenance checks passed. [Itemized acceptance](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/738#issuecomment-6704774541). Canonical authority-derived scope, immutable caller-intent, M/S/R/revision/error/proxy contracts and their original checklist remain OPEN. Native blockers/consumers unchanged; no downstream integration acceptance inferred.
<!-- /DM31:A01-LEGACY-CONSUMER-STATUS -->

### Test Design and Test Plan

All commands below are **planned acceptance**, except explicitly identified existing characterization commands. None was run as product verification by the planning session.

**Inputs and observable assertions:**
- Reject foreign scope and conflicting identity at the owning boundary
- No fake run before admission; unknown is not unaccepted

**Existing tests, new UT/ST, participants and substitutes:**
**Planned Command:** python3 -B -m unittest -v tests.server.st.test_dm31_a01

**Cases:** - Typed identity/error cases
- Existing wire-to-contract adapter fixture

**Participants:** Real immutable DTOs/public boundary validators; synthetic identity/error values. No Core, provider, database or phone required.


**Architecture and E2E obligations:** Run the relevant AR01–AR10 checks against the migrated module, with both legal and deliberately violating fixtures. Owner-boundary ST uses real public proxies and real temporary persistence; providers may be controlled and must be named. Independent QA runs affected unchanged-client scenarios when this capability enters the candidate assembly. No device pass is inferred from UT/ST.

**Required evidence:** exact base/head; source/target symbol diff; public API and state-owner map; command and exit status; distinct test count and skips; fixture inputs and expected/actual outcomes; real participants versus substitutes; before/after production dispatch trace; retained original failures; planned/unrun/blocked gates. For a migration, include M→S/R→Host operation→authoritative record identity and a negative bypass/reconnection result. No credentials or raw user content.

**Completion checklist:**
- [x] The observable result above is demonstrated by its normal and meaningful failure/concurrency cases.
- [x] For migrated behavior, the default configured production call path now reaches the new owner. A preparation/contract/QA task instead delivers its exact stated artifact and does not claim a production switch.
- [x] The old entry is removed or delegates only through published proxies; no duplicate authority, dual write or silent old-executor fallback remains for this migrated capability.
- [x] Reintroducing direct provider/storage calls or reconnecting the old executor makes the appropriate gate fail; the legal fixture still passes.
- [x] The extension interface, owner, exact test command and migration inventory are updated for subsequent feature developers.
- [x] Independent integration evidence is linked; task closure alone does not close the master architecture or main-behavior gate.

**Coverage:** foundation, C4. **Architecture rules / accepted contracts:** ADR0001, ADR0002, ADR0009.

Research: [main capabilities](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/main-capabilities.md), [architecture evidence](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/architecture-evidence.md), [CI and QA](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/gates-qa.md), [migration developer guide](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/developer-guide.md).

**Reuse classification:** Selective adaptation of named behavior and tests; new owner/contract implementation where legacy authority cannot be retained. Reference implementations are review inputs, not a whole-directory copy.

**Preserve:**
- Main child execution, vision, tools, office behavior
- Narrow diagnostic logging distinct from product persistence

**Remove or redirect authority / I/O:**
- Direct network/client construction and product history/checkpoint writes in Harness paths

**Writable boundary:**
- tools/architecture/harness_io.py
- tests/architecture/test_harness_io.py
- tests/server/st/test_harness_effects.py

**Read-only sources:** the source list above until an explicitly listed compatibility delegate is changed in this PR. Other owners' public interfaces are dependencies, not permission to edit their private modules. Original user checkout and other session worktrees remain read-only.

**Shared-type and state owners:** A01 owns core M/S/R/error public types; A14 owns hook/attempt/reservation contract coordination; Session Store owner exclusively serializes schema, admission, context, receipt and accounting records; Host lifecycle owner serializes dispatch/Stop/finalization. Request changes through their owning issues. This task owns only its declared module and tests.

**Rollback / persisted-format impact:** Keep compatibility reads and stable identities. For new persisted fields, declare the encoding/version and old-reader behavior with the Store owner before activation; unsupported downgrade fails closed. Before switching traffic, fence old writers and prove compatible readers. Rolling back new admissions never replays an unknown effect, restores legacy execution, changes a committed terminal, or discards unsettled accounting.

**Accepted scope and unresolved decisions:** No new authority or product semantic is accepted by this task. Any listed proposed interface is an implementation proposal under the frozen contracts.

### Test Design and Test Plan

All commands below are **planned acceptance**, except explicitly identified existing characterization commands. None was run as product verification by the planning session.

**Inputs and observable assertions:**
- Positive four-operation trace passes with real selected adapter
- Injected nested direct HTTP, database, and history write each fail
- Diagnostic sinks are exact reviewed entries, not directory exceptions

**Existing tests, new UT/ST, participants and substitutes:**
**Planned Command:** python3 scripts/ci/server-tests.py --suite harness-effects --require-tests --fail-on-skip

**Assertions:** - server-tests.py --suite harness-effects --require-tests --fail-on-skip (proposed)
- Static AR04 fixtures

**Participants:** Actual scanner and legal/violating fixtures; runtime suites use real owning public components/SQLite with controlled providers. G05 physically omits Core in its isolated installation. No phone/device claim.


**Architecture and E2E obligations:** Run the relevant AR01–AR10 checks against the migrated module, with both legal and deliberately violating fixtures. Owner-boundary ST uses real public proxies and real temporary persistence; providers may be controlled and must be named. Independent QA runs affected unchanged-client scenarios when this capability enters the candidate assembly. No device pass is inferred from UT/ST.

**Required evidence:** exact base/head; source/target symbol diff; public API and state-owner map; command and exit status; distinct test count and skips; fixture inputs and expected/actual outcomes; real participants versus substitutes; before/after production dispatch trace; retained original failures; planned/unrun/blocked gates. For a migration, include M→S/R→Host operation→authoritative record identity and a negative bypass/reconnection result. No credentials or raw user content.

**Completion checklist:**
- [ ] The observable result above is demonstrated by its normal and meaningful failure/concurrency cases.
- [ ] For migrated behavior, the default configured production call path now reaches the new owner. A preparation/contract/QA task instead delivers its exact stated artifact and does not claim a production switch.
- [ ] The old entry is removed or delegates only through published proxies; no duplicate authority, dual write or silent old-executor fallback remains for this migrated capability.
- [ ] Reintroducing direct provider/storage calls or reconnecting the old executor makes the appropriate gate fail; the legal fixture still passes.
- [ ] The extension interface, owner, exact test command and migration inventory are updated for subsequent feature developers.
- [ ] Independent integration evidence is linked; task closure alone does not close the master architecture or main-behavior gate.
